cookie.title: Enter Baidu Cookie
cookie.description:
Obtain your BDUSS cookie as follows:
1. Open the Baidu console in your browser and sign in
2. Press F12 to open DevTools, go to Application (应用) → Cookies
3. Find the entry named BDUSS and copy its value below

The BDUSS cookie is valid for about 180 days. It is only used to access your devices and is never uploaded to any third party.

data_description.cookie: The value of the BDUSS cookie (without the 'BDUSS=' prefix)

bemfa.title: Bemfa Cloud Configuration
bemfa.description:
Sync devices to Bemfa Cloud to enable voice control via smart speakers (e.g. Mi AI assistant). Leave all fields empty to skip.

Obtain your credentials after completing identity verification on Bemfa Cloud:
1. Log in to Bemfa Cloud console, open the "API Key" page
2. Copy your private key (UID), secretID, and secretKey
3. All three fields must be filled together to enable sync
